adapter_evidence.product_pages: https://www.vertiv.com/en-us/products-catalog/<category>/<subcategory>/<product>/ carries a native HTML 'Models' table (rating, voltage, efficiency, dimensions per model) and links official Data Sheet PDFs under /<hex>/globalassets/.
adapter_evidence.sitemap: https://www.vertiv.com/sitemap.xml redirects to a 404 page; no public product sitemap is declared in robots.txt.
adapter_evidence.chinese_site: The zh-cn catalog does not mirror en-us product slugs (404); only en-us product pages are in scope until a mapped Chinese source is reviewed.

known_gaps: No official product sitemap: new models are found only through bounded collection from declared category pages.
Chinese product pages are not collected because they do not share en-us product identities.
Datasheet PDFs need pdftotext on the collection host; the HTML Models table is preferred when present.
A product page groups several models; per-model rows stay inside the vendor table and are not split into separate products.
